results.title: Khushi Kapoor Brings Regal Glamour In A Custom Cut-Out Ensemble With Statement Choker At Mumbai Event
results.description: Khushi Kapoor brought a touch of royal glamour to Jo Malone London’s annual festive dinner in Mumbai, stepping out in a striking custom purple ensemble from designer Arpita Mehta. A version of the designer’s new collection, Ceremonial, the outfit beautifully blended traditional Indian craftsmanship with a contemporary silhouette.
